purpose: First-class non-sovereign entities that need full World Map identity/runtime behavior without changing the canonical 195 sovereign-country model.

label_anchor.note: Display anchor for the map label; not a population centroid.

orientations.note: Greenland is an explicit anchor in the recovered Canada–Greenland–North Atlantic North formulation; this is project interpretation, not a sovereignty claim.

relationships.note: Greenland is a self-governing part of the Kingdom of Denmark.

FRO.name: Faroe Islands
FRO.note: Entity semantics are registered now; the current World Map geometry source does not need to fabricate a polygon to represent it.

ATA.name: Antarctica
ATA.sovereignty_context: Antarctic Treaty System; represented here as a geographic non-sovereign map entity.

orientations.note: Antarctica contains the geographic South Pole and is used as the polar anchor of the project South field. This is a project/map interpretation and does not imply sovereignty or political authority.

ATA.note: Antarctica has no ordinary permanent resident national population; the map leaves population unknown rather than converting seasonal research presence into a country-style population value.
